criteria.reason: Explicitly identifies false dilemma; lists multiple intermediate options (targeted surveillance, cooperation, community engagement, coordination).
Names security vs. liberty/privacy as the tension, though frames it as a 'false tradeoff'.
Avoids specific law or vote but argues one-sidedly that mass surveillance is ineffective and harmful.
Swiss 2016 vote omitted; citations vague and undated (GAO), country comparisons unverifiable.

position: mass surveillance unnecessary and harmful; balanced targeted approaches preferred
summary: Rejects the false dichotomy and names the security-privacy tension with middle options, but argues one-sidedly against mass surveillance and omits dated evidence such as the 2016 Swiss vote.
